sanskrit: śrameṇa tapasā sṛṣṭā brahmaṇā vittarte śritā | satyenāvṛtā śriyā prāvṛtā yaśasā parivṛtā svadhayā parihitā śraddhayā paryūḍhā dīkṣayā guptā yajñe pratiṣṭhitā loko nidhanam ||
english: Created by exertion and austerity, she rests sheltered in Brahman; enveloped by truth, clothed in splendour, encompassed by fame, girt round with svādhā, borne along by faith, guarded by consecration, established in sacrifice — the world is her final abode.

sanskrit: chandāṃsi rūpam aṅgirasaḥ santāpā brahma padavā- -ayaṃ brāhmaṇo 'dhipatiḥ | tām ādadānasya brahmagavīṃ jinato brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyasya | apa krāmati sūnṛtā vīryaṃ puṇyā lakṣmīḥ ||
english: The metres are her form, the Aṅgirases her fervour, Brahman her path — this Brāhmaṇa is her sovereign lord. From that kṣatriya who seizes her — the cow of Brahman — and thereby despoils the Brāhmaṇa, sweet speech departs, heroic power departs, and auspicious prosperity departs.
